newsitem.title: ITALY: MOTORCYCLING-DOOHAN TAKES ITALIAN GRAND PRIX POLE.
newsitem.headline: MOTORCYCLING-DOOHAN TAKES ITALIAN GRAND PRIX POLE.

text.p: World champion Michael Doohan held off team mate Alex Criville in final qualifying on Saturday to take pole position for the Italian 500cc motorcycling Grand Prix on Sunday.

Doohan, also the fastest on Friday, clocked one minute 53.387 seconds on his 22nd lap of the hour-long session at the Mugello track north of Florence, one of the Australian's favourite venues after four wins here in four years.

Criville, who won the last round of the world championship in his native Spain to close to five points behind leader Doohan in the standings after three races, clocked 1:53.789 with his 27th and last lap of the day.
Both Honda riders were inside the official lap record of 1:53.829 set by Doohan during the 1993 Grand Prix but outside Doohan's 1996 circuit best of 1:53.260.
Times were considerably faster than during Friday's qualifying session, with the top 10 all improving on a hot and bright afternoon after showers the previous day.
Tadayuki Okada put another Honda on the front row of the grid with the third fastest time while Aprilia rider Doriano Romboni made sure a local rider was there too.
Hondas filled seven of the top 10 slots on the grid.
